comments: Cozy and characteristic space. Everything you could need for a trip, and lots to do in the area.
Keith, is awesome. Made sure we had everything we needed and then did an amazing job to make sure we had all the privacy we needed. Was a great value for the price.
I had a very nice stay. Darcy was always helpful and responsive. Great location as well.

Rick was an excellent host! We were especially impressed with the thoughtful amenities like the Keurig with an assortment of coffee pods, and a couple beers upon our arrival.
The bedrooms are beautifully appointed, the beds were comfortable and the backyard was perfect!
If you want a nice, comfortable, cozy stay that’s 5 minutes away from all that NashVegas has to offer, this is the place!

Outstanding!!!  That describes my six-night stay at Nita's property.  My adult son and I fully enjoyed our visit to Austin and a large part of that was due to the beautiful accommodations afforded us as guests in Nita's home.  Nita was very clear and responsive to any questions or needs that we had.  The house had everything that we required.  Peaceful neighborhood, easy access to all Austin destinations and my favorite – a beautiful fenced in yard at the back of the house with a covered deck.  The back deck was the perfect start and finish to every day.  Again “OUTSTANDING”.

Can't say enough good things about our stay, Farhad is a wonderful host and person. Home was in a beautiful, lively, and convienent location with plenty to do and was equipt with all sorts of appliances and amenities. Our group loved how open Farhad was with letting us use his equipment to jam in the downstairs half-basement turned practice space. Would love to stay here again in the future. Thanks again, Farhad!

Max's place in Austin was perfect for my ten day stay. It is in a very cute neighborhood, walkable to many destinations, and seemingly everywhere I wanted to drive was within 5-15 minutes. The home was clean and Max was very accommodating, answering all of my questions about his home and Austin. I highly recommend this location if you are visiting Austin. I hope to be able to return to Austin and will definitely stay here if available in future.
Very clean, comfortable and stocked with everything I needed.
Very nice stay. Was very comfortable , and was a great location with a lot of things to do nearby. 10/10 would recommend and stay again.
The place was clean and conveniently located downtown. The directions from the app go to the wrong street, I mentioned this to the owner, they were apologetic.

Our stay at Cal’s Airbnb was fantastic! The place was spotless, very comfortable, and you can’t beat the location right over the Boot Barn on Broadway. Despite being in the heart of all the action, noise was never an issue. Cal’s communication was excellent and made everything easy. Would definitely stay here again!
Loved the location
Jennifer's place is great. It has a lot of great restaurants and bars within walking distance. Her airbnb has all the amenities you can think of. I enjoyed my stay and would recommend to anyone.

The back porch at this house makes it special. It overlooks a hilly green section of Seattle and your nestled amongst the pines so it feels very private and as if you are in a green forest.  On summer nights the porch is dreamy. The house is furnished in a very tasteful way and is very clean. The location is fabulous because you can walk to Moderna and restaurants there and  have a selection of grocery store on East Union St. as well.  Very central located to the rest of Seattle and walking distance from the Arboretum.

장점: 시애틀 다운타운 위치. 다운타운 명소 다 걸어다닐 수 있음. 특히 Starbucks roastery 매우 가까움. 숙소랑 지하철역이랑 5분 거리라 야구장, 미식축구 구장, 워싱턴 대학교도 금방 갈 수 있음. 친절한 호스트. 간단한 스낵 준비.
단점: 숙소가 좀 으슥한 데 있어서 밤에 노숙자나 대마초 피우는 사람들 종종 마주칠 수 있으나, 이건 시애틀 전체 문제이고 밤 늦게 외출 안 하면 됨.
장점이 단점보다 압도적으로 많은 숙소👍

Ted’s place was great. Very cute and in a nice neighborhood. Convenient to get around. And within walking distance to several restaurants. Definitely recommend eating at Communion. Ted was very accommodating. Thanks for a great stay!

This is a great place to stay. Janet and Glenn are wonderful hosts. It was clean and in a quiet neighborhood. It is close to everything but far enough to be very safe and quiet. We will happily stay here again on our next trip to Nashville.
Departamento muy cómodo. Vladimir es un excelente anfitrión. Me sentí como en casa.

Sebastian was very accommodating, from an early check-in, and to a late check out, even though I did not take a vantage of it. I had a minor accident and fell at the airport company arrival, and he help me with some first aid supplies I like the private, en suite bathroom, and I texted Sebastian. He was always responsive, and generally quickly this was a great place to stay, and the value and location are outstanding, situated between two blue line subway stops, Damen and Division. I would stay here again
Gorgeous condo with a great host! The neighborhood is great and there’s a ton to do in the area. Charissa was responsive and helpful. I highly recommend her place.
Great stay and very quiet, perfect for getting work done.

I was in Austin on a business trip. When I told my hosts of an important part of my trip, they were so encouraging and supportive. Catherine and Patrick are very kind, and their home was just perfect for my needs. I loved the cleanliness, the comfortable bed, the decor, and the many books. I just wish I had more time to peruse them. I felt very comfortable in their home and safe in their trendy neighborhood, and I would definitely request to stay again the next time I'm in Austin.
I highly recommend this lovely bungalow!

Aliza was a very friendly and responsive host and her place was classy and beautiful. She had thought of everything by way of amenities and every little thing we needed in the kitchen and bathroom. We enjoyed a very comfortable stay. Would highly recommend this place!

Amazing location with easy access to river, creeks and trails - and Zilker Pool, dining,  music, etc. Huge backyard. The house has everything you need for adults, kids and pups. Easy communication with owners. Many many highlights to our stay but will call out the owners sound system as Lollapalooza was live on Hulu and had a blast enjoying it from Austin  👍
Rachael’s condo in Seattle is awesome! Walking distance from so many things to do. Very neat and cozy, we would definitely stay here again.
The home was immaculate,  very hospitable and wonderful hosts to work with. Definitely recommend this home!

The gorgeous yard is absolutely the star of this cute bungalow. We arrived late summer & so much was blooming - we loved it. It’s very walkable, super cute neighborhood, restaurants nearby. My bed in the master was very comfortable. Wished we could have stayed longer.
Lovely and very unique (Think Grandmother house feel, antique) place to stay!! LOVED ❤️🙌
I really enjoyed my time there and it was very peaceful as well as clean. I would pay to go back so they’re doing an amazing job!
Loved it, very quiet, feels like home

The place needs improvements inside and out; overgrown bushes, cluttered, dirty, moldy. The cleaning service needs to be improved. Pictures are different than reality. The bedrooms had to be swept given the dusty and hairy condition presented. Also a good declutter should be implemented, we do believe that the home has a great potential to became really enjoyable.
Christie did respond quick to our
Communications.

I was in Austin for a conference downtown and had a wonderful stay at Gail’s place this week. The home is beautiful, clean and artfully decorated and located in a great neighborhood close to downtown. The room has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Gail and Bill are thoughtful and generous hosts, providing snacks and breakfast items to accommodate my busy schedule and friendly conversation on both ends of the day. They had me feeling like family in no time!
Very cute and charming place in a lovely neighborhood. Everything was super clean and check-in was easy! Thank you so much.
Although we didn't use the amenities, knowing they were there was nice. Very comfortable space and great for a short or long stay.  if ever back, they are the ideal place to stay.
Super accommodating and great location.
Incredible!! Great location and the views!  Fun visiting the needle and market . We really enjoyed every minute of our stay .   Highly recommended!

This place was so sweet! I loved the lay out and the beds were really soft and comfortable. You can definitely tell that people actually live there - but in a way that makes it a great place to stay because everything you need is truly there. I love the chickens!!!!!! Love them! There were even fresh eggs left for us. It was a shared space (the owner stayed in the basement the first night) which I felt a little bad about because we were coming back a little late from a welcome party for a wedding - but that’s okay! The hot tub was also lovely. It was truly a lovely stay.

The place is basically in front of Wrigley! Great for baseball fans. It's a great location, with lots of restaurants and bars super close, most places are open late, and it's close to bus stops and metro stations to be able to move around the city. Parking onsite is very convenient. My only critiques echo others, the place is slightly more dated than pics make it seem and it could use more towel hooks. Josh is a very responsive host. I also appreciate that all he asks you to worry about when checking out is making sure everything is where it's supposed to and that the place isn't trashed.

Fabulous Place! so much space with everything you need for a great stay. the host is very friendly and always answered any questions quickly. we went during a very hot week, but there was plenty of fans and with all the windows open, it was totally fine!
The only thing we saw could use some improvements was the blinds. it was very bright in the mornings. we usually travel with black trash bags and painters tape to cover windows, but with it being so hot, that option wasn't available. it would have been nice to have some heavy duty curtains to pull shut when needed.
otherwise this place is perfect!! we slept great in the beds and had plenty of room! we drove down to the water taxi on several occasions for cheap easy trips to the city. highly recommend this house and will definitely be returning!

I dont where to start.
Faith and Ric are excellent host, my stay was THE best I have ever experienced. They are friendly, caring and very compassionate people. If you are ever in the Twin cities and need a quiet, clean, and peaceful place to stay for an extend period of time. do not hesitate to choose their place. you will not be disappointed.

Olivia tres acceuillante et serviable. J’aime bien cet appartement c’est la 2eme fois que j’y viens.
Propre, bien range et pratique.
Supermarche a 200 metres.
Parkings toujours libres.
Parfait.

Beautiful views of Portage Bay through big windows in the main room.  Very comfortable sofa and bed.  The kitchenette is well supplied and there is a toaster oven, microwave and outdoor grill to support cooking, as there is no stove or oven.  You can hear noise from the owners above but the apartment feels private and the neighborhood is peaceful and calming.  Great location, easy to get around all parts of Seattle and there is parking available in the driveway.  Highly recommend.
Great host and great location! Walked to a Cubs game from the spot.

Armando was an amazing host, and he provides an amazing place to stay. Having a gorgeous place to stay made my trip all the more fun. I was never worried about reaching out to Armando for questions, and he always made sure to respond and help out quickly. The place is so close to a bus stop that everything in Chicago is easy to get with a bus pass. Similarly it’s very easy to walk/bus to the blue line.
Chelsea was great to work with the house was exceptional. My grouped loved it and would stay again!
Had a great stay at Maureen's Airbnb. Nice neighbourhood that isn't too far from Washington University. Good amenities and comfortable place
Great location.  Very clean and well stocked
Muy buena experiencias.

Great deal, very clean room and restroom, well maintained historical building, and transportation is convenient. Loved to make our coffee in the morning and started the day calmly in the room :) highly recommend and we will definitely come back!

Randy was an excellent host. Very accommodating concerning any requests or questions I had. The flat lies in a quiet, beautiful neighbourhood and as very well connected to public transport (downtown or to the UW campus). Shops, cafe's and restaurant are plentiful and only a short walk away. Since I prepared several homemade meals during my two-month stay, I can also say that the kitchen is well-equiped, (unless you plan to prepare any more elaborate meals).
We loved staying at Holly's place. It was perfect for the show we were attending at Union Depot. I would definitely stay there again.

Great place to come and stay for a long time the people living at the Guadalupe Macro House it's friendly and will make you feel like home. There is also a lot of extra activities that will be a great surprise when you stay there.

I stayed here for a month while apartment hunting. I’m glad I did! It was a nice spot to land in a new city. My favorite part was the proximity to Green Lake — ran there several times a week. Lovely green space that always has lots of other walkers, runners, and nature enjoyers.
The apartment was quiet and clean and had everything I needed. There are pots & pans, knives, silverware, plates, bowls, mugs, glasses, cutting board, measuring cups, veggie peeler — everything I needed in the kitchen. It was also nice to have some starter soaps and shampoo/conditioner, as well as TP and paper towels.
Property manager Miles is so kind and helpful, and always there if you need anything! He went above and beyond to supply some hangers for the closet even though he was under the weather that day.
Wallingford (45th Street) had plenty of food places, and the QFC grocery store is convenient. I loved Almanqal, recommend for the lamb kebab over rice and the pita and hummus.

This was such a wonderful stay. The place is so cute with great and thoughtful touches. Loved the window seat for reading and the bed was very comfy. The back garden that you walk through to get to your private entrance adds to the experience of the place. They even had some basic foods ready for us in the room along with a wonderfully smelling bouquet. Loved being able to walk to Barton springs. The apartment was also nice and cool, even in August. Loved our stay
Being downtown you get to see a lot of the activity and walk to it all from this location.
Very cute place, well taken care of by Randy. Clean and tidy. Would love to stay again!
great place and provided suggestions for someone visiting Austin

Jesse was an Awesome Host. Always was responsive and wanted to make sure I was comfortable. Totally recommend this location to anyone who wants a quite and peaceful area with great hostility for an extended amount of time. felt like home.

The space was as exactly as expected, with the friendlies host(s).  Oslo and Louie made sure we were tucked in at night (as we asked) and Gavin gave us extremely useful tips to navigate the area, transportation, and places to visit that were right up our ally.
This place is magical, i will definitely do what I can to stay here again next time I’m in town. Thanks Molly!!
Great place to stay! Very comfortable and spacious for two. We enjoyed coffee in the morning in the little backyard! Great hosts.
Clean, comfortable accommodations. Wonderful host.

We had a fantastic time in Chicago. The apartment is very clean and charming. The location is great, close to restaurants, shopping, Wrigley and train.The neighborhood is lively.  John is a great host. He is very responsive and gave us some great suggestions. We highly recommend John’s place and will be back.
Nice and quiet.  Comfortable, with desk, fridge and microwave and own bathroom.
Enjoy your place !.
Great place to stay for a month while working in Nashville. Wes was super responsive and great to work with! Highly recommend!
Stylish immaculate large private space, close to Northgate snd Carkeek park. Quiet, safe, nicely furnished, convenient mini-kitchen, responsive host, nice garden view.

We had a wonderful stay at Phuong’s apartment in Seattle! It’s very easy to get here from the airport — just take the light rail ($3 ticket for adults) and walk about 15 minutes from Westlake station.
The location is perfect: everything is within walking distance. Pike Place Market with its excellent restaurants, the iconic Space Needle, and the amazing Chihuly Glass Museum are all nearby. Many tours also start close to the apartment — for example, trips to Mount Rainier or Twin Peaks waterfalls.
Phuong is a very proactive host who provides clear and helpful instructions, which made the whole experience smooth and enjoyable.
Highly recommend staying here!
Run-down but functional property in a very nice location.

Todd’s Airbnb was just as listed! It was very clean, comfortable, quiet and all in all a really nice space to stay. He had everything you could need and a basket with snacks and a great bottle of wine! What a surprise! I am also super picky about cleanliness and his place was extremely clean. We will definitely stay here in the future! Thank you, Todd, for being a wonderful host.

unbelievable.Ii actually wanted to extend my stay because I will be renting in that building but somebody had got it for the next weekend. That was after the first month. Everything you need is there. Ive lived in the neighboorhood for 8 years and was fighting to find a good new apartment. Still looking unfortunately but thats Lakeview and Wriggleyville. Patio is amazing. Every amenity you want. Awesome neighrbors. So dog friendly. Even security is nice. i will find a rental in there. lol. but 5 out of 5 all day.

My husband and I and our dogs enjoyed our stay at Brenda's place. It was clean, peaceful, easy to find, and we loved the wood floors and the colorful kitchen. The beds were comfortable, and the neighborhood is gorgeous. Brenda was proactive with instructions and very friendly. We would happily stay here again! :)
Great place! We felt super comfortable staying here and loved being in the heart of downtown! It felt like home, we would highly recommend this spot!
Great stay.  Good location.  Super responsive owner.
Cute little spot in perfect location
We have stayed here several times. It’s great for gathering family and friends in the huge kitchen.
So happy to stay at Briena’s for the third time, and finally get to meet her in person. She’s an amazing host and we love staying at her place when we are in Nashville. Highly recommend!
Tolle was very helpful and kind! The property is in a nice, safe, and quiet neighborhood. The place was comfy and clean. I had a great stay!

This place was perfect and right on the middle of everything!  It is located on a busy road but you can’t hear any of the traffic from inside.  I felt safe and we had everything we needed to enjoy Nashville!!
Had a wonderful time on my visit, Juliette was very responsive and was a great host. Very easy check-in and check-out. Instructions were very clear and helpful.

page.
I felt right at home. I loved the private entrance, comfortable bed and furniture.
Nice to have a frig, microwave and coffee maker plus snacks, coffee and oatmeal provided. A TV with Netflix and Prime was a welcome addition. I also loved the Aussie theme and the other colorful decorations.
The owner is a musician and Neil Young fan as am I so that was also great. I would stay there again in a heartbeat.
Good location!! Would recommend
Nice spot in a residential neighborhood. Alice was a great host, very responsive.

My husband and I enjoyed our stay at Angela's place! It was clean, cozy and spacious. Great location and about 10-20 minutes from everything we wanted to do/see. Easy check-in and easy communication! Would stay here again!
It was a really nice stay at Dao’s place ☺️ it is a quiet and peaceful apartment, Dao is super helpful and kind so I felt at ease. Thank you Dao!
Great little get away not terribly far from the cities/airport! We certainly would, and plan to, stay again!
Was a good place to stay for a night in the twin cities. House is a bit old so it shouldn’t be expected like a new house. House is nice and cozy though, and Thomas was great

The location was absolutely fantastic! The lake and Seward park are within walking distance — we were able to rent a kayak right down the street. It is also conveniently close to downtown (only about a 15 minute drive). The house is great for kids, from the gaming room in the basement to the trampoline in the backyard. All in all, a great place to stay.

great place: perfect for a couple or tiny family and met all of out needs! Jon was attentive and patient & this spot will definitely be our top choice for return trips because of locality and the home’s warm, inviting and overall comfortable vibe. it really iis adorable! the bed is comfy, the kitchen has an abundance of pots n pans which we appreciate as home-cooks! aand, the tiny backyard (mosquitoes spray included!💗) completes the home vibe - a nice perk for smokers or vapers. I wish I had left a review in time our first time around because this place absolutely earns its 5 stars! ⭐️✨ thanks again Jon, always much appreciated!
Alan was a great host. The place easily accommodated a group of 10. It was larger than we had anticipated and much more pleasant. The pictures don’t do the place justice. Overall 10/10 spot.
We really enjoyed our stay here! The house is located in a walkable area with lots of restaurants and shops, it is also close to a bus line that brings you right into the heart of the city.

This place was so cute and cozy! Me and my friends stayed here for 3 days/nights and loved our stay. The beds were sure comfy (me and my friends stayed shared one and there was plenty of room) and the bathroom was very nice. The little kitchenette did its job, the stove was small but mighty, and the dresser they have was plenty of room for all of my clothes in one drawer (if you want to hang your clothes bring some hangers as there aren’t very many) The host was also super friendly and was super quick to respond to any questions I had, however I didn’t have very many because the instructions were super clear. Overall, we had an amazing stay and loved it, would highly recommend!
Great stay. The location was amazing. Close to downtown Seattle but also quiet and in a cute neighborhood. It was clean and easy to get into. Would 100% stay here again.
Tara’s place was perfect for our family. There was space for me to work from as well as living and dining space. The bedrooms worked well, and our dog loved the yard and eating apples that fell!

We enjoyed our 3-day stay in Travis’ place. The apartment is part of a duplex but is very private. It was comfortable, clean, with a fully stocked kitchen and bathroom. The bed was comfortable as well. We loved our morning coffee in the front yard under the apple tree. The apartment has a unique character and style, lovingly restored to its current charm. We will stay here again.
Extremely functional and well thought out home! It was perfect for us.
Frankie was immensely friendly and super accommodating!
Good location, clean place. Leslie and Brian communicated very well and were accommodating.

The location is in a very nice neighborhood. We brought our dog with us and we were able to walk around on the sidewalks.  The living space was very cozy and clean.  Beds were really comfortable. During our stay, the air conditioner unit stopped working. And Molly promptly fixed the situation. We would highly recommend this carriage house !!
This was an excellent location right on Buffalo Lake. The hosts even provided us with kayaks to use during our stay. We felt right at home and will look to stay here again in the future!
Beautiful Neighborhood, super close to the pink line train. Colby was an amazing host, she was very informative and super kind. The place was safe, and next to so many small businesses and eateries.

This sweet and cozy river cabin was such a wonderful delight. Ann had all details covered along with great communication and expectations to our stay. Spending time at this beautiful property left us feeling relaxed and refreshed. We look forward to visiting again.
We had a great stay here. Excellent location, easy parking, spacious and comfortable. Highly recommend.

The kitchen table (and it was sticky we put a blanket on it) was the only place to sit and talk.
The mattresses were sagging. The whole building smelled like a mixture of mildew, marijuana and curry. The air conditioner was so noisy you couldn't hear the tv. The apartment is not "modern" as stated. Its more like motel 6 in the 70's.
Even though it is an old building the stairwells and hallways could have been updated .

We enjoyed our opportunity to talk with Alex.  He told us all about his chickens and is an incredible gardener with lots of fruit trees and unique plants.  The location was great, within walking distance of a walkway along a creek and close distance to many restaurants and stores.  We had a very enjoyable stay.
Location Location Location!!

We enjoyed our long stay. Thank you for letting us take over the farmhouse for over a month! Everything was stocked with essentials, kitchen, rooms, bathrooms, etc. Wifi worked great for working remotely. The home was nice and the property is beautiful. Very peaceful. We even had an eagle come and visit us a few times a week! We felt right at home. Sabrina was very responsive when we had questions. There are a few bars and restaurants nearby as well as a quick drive to Red Wing for groceries. Great location for a country living vibe,  just a few minutes drive from everything you could possibly want or need while staying .
This location is everything, so many great places within walking distance! And a very cozy place to stay 😊
I had a lovely stay. Quiet and peaceful. Close to shops and restaurants. Awesome location! Good wifi. Host very quick to respond.

Incredibly clean, spacious, functional, and beautifully decorated.  Beds were very comfortable. Fun to learn about all the history with the 145 year old house. I would recommend this place to anyone that is staying in the Minneapolis area.
Excellent place to stay.

Mel and her team were awesome, we felt right at home.  Comfy spot, and lots of choices to eat in the area within minutes of the spot.  Local groceries were also easy to find and get to when you just wanted a quiet night at home.  Puppy loved the backyard and would find him taking naps under the trees and chasing the local pair of squirrels.  This was such an awesome place to land as we travel across the country and now proudly get to call Nashville home.

This may be the first 100% perfect review we've given 😂. Sam and Lyn were truly lovely hosts: caring, proactive, highly communicative, friendly, warm, flexible - everything you could want in a host, or even just a human!
* The place was surprisingly spacious and well decorated.
* The furniture is comfortable and higher quality than usual airbnb furniture.
* The kitchen was quite well stocked (various sizes of good heavy pots and pans (although some flaking teflon); ample utensils; ample plates, bowls, glasses and cutlery; decent knives; cutting boards; round cake pans; 9x13 cake pans; broiling pans; only thing they didn't have was a cookie sheet)
* The area was very safe, very vibrant, and highly walkable
* There's a bustling Mexican grocery across the street, a slightly more diverse market down the street a little, and a big fancy Mariano's two miles down the road.
* Lots of hispanic and middle-eastern restaurants
* etc...
Really a lovely stay. Highly recommend!
Maria is a passionate woman who helps me a lot, I love the experience here, I think the location of the house is cool because have a lot of storages and markets and good restaurants ..
great place for a family or get together house was so much bigger than what i thought it was originally loved my stay beautiful place would recommend !

My family & I had a great stay here. The host was super responsive, and the place was clean and so thoughtfully stocked (water in fridge, blue line passes, coffee & creamer, body wash/shampoo/conditioner, etc.) We would recommend!
Tashara must be your choice when staying in Austin Texas!!!
Host was very attentive and made sure we had everything we needed during our stay.  Would stay here again.

Great place if you are looking for a long term rental and a want a Minnesota cabin feel! We’ve been staying here every summer for the past four years and love every minute of it! Anton is great and he will go above and beyond to make sure you are comfortable! As always, highly recommend! Thanks my friend and see you next year!

George's place was very comfortable, homey, cozy!  It was as described and George checked in a few times to make sure we were comfortable.  Very friendly and accommodating.  I would highly recommend for those looking for a quiet, peaceful stay when attending events in the area.  I wished I could have stayed longer on Sunday to walk some of the trails, but I had to get home for other obligations.

We truly enjoyed our stay….it was wonderful to have our dog Miles welcome and the fenced in backyard made it a safe place for him. The whole vibe was very comfortable and warm, we felt right at home. It was very well stocked with anything we needed and the kitchen was an amazing place to cook.  Thank you for the amazing hospitality  Randee!

Loved everything about this location! From the actual location to our hostesses. The response time was always speedy & she even had a gift for my daughter upon arrival. So thoughtful & is also going the extra mile to send a ring back my daughter left. Thank you so much for the hospitality. If you are looking for a safe CLEAN location with lots to do look no further this is your go to spot!

Absolutely lovely place to rent! Was perfect for me and my mom’s trip to see the Vikings vs Falcons game- stadium is a nice and safe 10 minute walk from the Airbnb. Would rent again if we find our way up to MN again. Thanks Chris!
I didn’t stay the night, I felt uncomfortable
great place really enjoyed my time.  Very professional and considerate host.
This place was very clean. It was a great reasonably priced home.

Marks place was a great find!
Very clean, everything we needed.
Loved the extra snacks, choice of beverages, comfortable furniture.
We discovered great restaurants nearby and the location was convenient to the highways.

Erica was very friendly and proactive, the check-in process and instructions were easy. Her place looked like the photos and also she had lots of goodies for us to use and snacks to eat. We felt right at home.

This rental is immaculate. The styling is spot-on, the finishes are upscale. No shortcuts were taken in the preparation of this place. I wish more hosts had this level of attention to detail! I highly recommend.
Excellent stay. Made me feel right at home in Seattle. Excellent and extremely responsive host. 10/10!
hi for all turist renting this property i rcomend as a yes for this property both is nor 5 star how is on the picture
Nice! Great location and clean home
Was told I had a private bath, only to find out it was shared during day two of my stay. Also noisy late at night.

We visited Nashville for my sister-in-laws bachelorette. Sean made everything so easy. Everything was spotless and the location was close to everything (we Ubered because it was in a slightly sketchy looking neighborhood but we felt safe the whole time we just didn’t want to walk as a group of 6 girls in an unfamiliar place. The Ubers were very cheap too! Maybe $5 per person to get downtown). There were cooking basic, comfy beds, clean linens, and shampoo, conditioner, and body wash in the shower and everything to feel right at home. We would recommend and stay again 😊

We had a wonderful time staying here. The house is a lovely Victorian, and it was very comfortable. Our host was very easy to communicate with. The house is located in a very walkable and safe area. There are plenty of restaurants and you are just a few blocks away from #12 trolley stop at the farmers market. we had a wonderful stay and would stay again.
6 rooms in the flat to share two bathrooms. One bathroom does not have hot water, so sometimes there is a wait for the good shower or you are stuck taking a cold shower if you are in a rush.
Very nice place.

Great apartment! Smooth check-in, good communication, great location. Can't say enough good things about this apartment
Can't recommend enough. Will be back
good

Deirdre’s apartment was beautiful, clean, and in an exceptional location. We particularly enjoyed the private patio as well as the rooftop view of the Space Needle and Belltown. It was close to Pike Place Market and a variety of good coffee shops and restaurants. The apartment itself felt very cozy. I would recommend the Oasis!

The property exceeded my expectations and felt like home for the last week - cozy and comfortable. Jordan was a thoughtful & responsive host and provided very helpful & detailed instructions. Would happily stay here again!

Great location and quiet neighborhood. Unit was well equipped and clean. We had a car and found it best to  park up the street in the evening, rather than move the car in the morning. I would stay here again!

The Airbnb was exactly what was shown in the photos, the host provided great communication. The only thing that wasn't perfect was that the upstairs toilet was a little dirty otherwise, everything else was great. I would definitely stay here again.
We loved our stay, Helen was very helpful with everything you can imagine. Space was clean and location was good and safe. Would highly recommend!
We were very pleased with this house. The beds were comfortable, the kitchen had everything we needed, and the master bath was amazing.

Our family had to stay a few months while we were waiting for our home to be sold. Mitesh was very friendly, responsive, and always helpful with any questions or concerns I had. Both bathrooms were clean and nice. Bedrooms were spacious and comfortable, and the kitchen was great as well. Our favorite thing was having Horner Park nearby, so we could take our dogs to play there every day. Mitesh was a great host and I definitely recommend staying here!

I wish it was as well-cared for inside as it was outside. It felt rather dirty and dingy the whole time we stayed.  The couch was so dirty we never sat on it, the barstool chairs are all ripped, nearly every wall has weird stains, there is a wall of peeling paint and mold spots in bathroom. Every white towel had stains, so we immediately went and bought our own towels. The shower liner upstairs was moldy, so I bought a new one and replaced it (you are welcome, whomever stays next). There are no dressers, and only a couple random hangers. One bedroom closet doesn't open. The TV had no working volume for our entire stay. Neighbors can be heard very easily. Basketball courts out back were very loud until around 9:30 in the evenings. On the positive side, the neighbors throughout the neighborhood were very nice and the location is close to many food and shopping options. The beds were comfortable and there were plenty of dishes for cooking and eating.
We decided not to stay at this property.

I had such an amazing time being in Seattle for the first time ever and staying at Jill and Joel’s place. The second I walked in my jaw dropped at how amazingly clean everything was and the attention to detail they took to make this place into such homey vibe. It had every single thing you could think of. I appreciate the little things they added like the pitcher of water and snacks for my hike. Location was perfect to where I wanted to adventure off to for the few days I was there. I can’t wait to come back to Seattle and I will most definitely be staying here again. Thank you Jill and Joel so very much for making my experience in Washington a trip I’ll never forget!
The place was beautiful  nice set up. Host was kind left clear directions.
Our family really enjoyed our stay at Tracy’s home. It was just what we needed to spend some quality time together.

We ran a little late on our check out due to a very minor medical issue and she was very understanding. I really appreciated that. The location is very quiet and peaceful but not walking distance to restaurants or cafes so it depends on your needs. The back yard was cute and seems nice for a coffee or chat but we didn't have time. Owner lives above but very separate. Sometimes hear a little pitter-patter of her dog's paws but never barking. Appliances a bit dated but work and is appropriate to the cost of the place. Seattle is crazy expensive and we looked for a good price. This was perfect for our group of  3.
Wonderful place, lots of room, very comfortable, clean, and easy to get to a lot of Nashville attractions. The Host was very responsive.
Rachel was a great host! Super communicative and the space filled all of our needs!

We rented this unit specifically for an event at the United Center.  It's extremely close, quiet at night (the "L" is just a few blocks away but could barely be heard), and Zed was very communicative for the few questions that I had.  Easy access in terms of checking in and very few requirements at check out.
We especially enjoyed the nice big island and kitchen area. It was fun to stay in a historic house that has been updated and was very comfortable.
The room is very clean and it's very comfortable to live in.
Incredible communication throughout our stay. Would happily book again.
Great stay. Thanks!
We enjoyed our stay in this lovely place. The walking path was close by. We were able to walk to stores & restaurants. It was also easy to get to the city from here.

This was such a wonderful home! Joseph was a great host and we truly appreciate his hospitality! Very responsive, communicates well, and the home was just perfect for our family! Close to everything, wonderful neighbors and just a very great experience! We would recommend a thousand times! Thank you Joseph!

Lyle was a great host, and his place was perfect for walking to and from our event in downtown Seattle. The condo itself was in excellent condition and worked perfectly for my group. We would happily stay there again if we were visiting Seattle.
The only minor issue we encountered—through no fault of the host—was with Google Maps. The app shows the entrance in the wrong place, so be sure to follow the directions provided rather than relying on Google once you get close, especially if you are driving to this location.
We were comfortable at this house, especially because it was close to my work

I had a great stay.  An upper floor was assigned to me, with a bedroom, bathroom and a dining/efficiency kitchen/sofa room. The bed was comfortable, I had everything needed.  I think others have mentioned low head height in a shower, and a hand held shower head helps to make things workable. It was quiet and easy to access. Near to so many destinations.  Donna was a gracious host.
Great space and close to Broadway!

The place was immaculate. I had the opportunity to meet the owner and he was gracious and helpful. I would definitely stay here again.
And Thank You to Chiaki!
It's great place to stay.

An absolute gem! I loved every minute here. Both porches (enclosed and outdoors) are great spaces for meals and relaxing. The neighborhood is beautiful and calm, while still being central to everything we wanted to do.
Good value

Very convenient and well equipped apartment in a trendy ethnic neighborhood. Great restaurants 1/2 a block away. Our host provided a detailed list of food and service recommendations. Don't miss the Michelin rated Thai. Private parking for our large SUV!. Easy trip into Downtown Chicago. Highly recommend.

There were six of us visiting Austin for an early Thanksgiving at our son's house. Fuad's home was on the same street, so the location could not have been better.  It was clean, comfortable and had everything we needed for a wonderful stay.

We enjoyed our stay, clear instructions and it was clean. Few things to note 1. It’s about $40 one way from/to airport $15 to broadway. There is a stadium behind the property so if there’s a game uber/lyfts aren’t allowed so you have to walk a tad (not bad) to get there bc of the blocking. Overall the host communication was 1000/10 and we had a great time.
Great place to stay if your looking to relax with privacy. Place is clean and host is very responsive. 10/10 would stay again!
Close to downtown, very quiet neighborhood and spotless house! It was perfect.
Wonderful outdoor atmosphere. Very cute and comfortable, would definitely book again 😄
This host has such a great location. Very walkable to everything in the Gulch and beyond. Super clean and great amenities.

The customer service was top notch! We loved the location as it was just a 10-15 min uber ride to all the action. There are lots of food options nearby as well as a Walmart. It was very clean and very comfortable. Would definitely stay again!
always have a good stay here! no complaints ever
I had an excellent stay!
It was a great spot, with excellent dining options nearby. Will definitely keep them in mind for future visits.

Absolutely amazing place in the heart of Chicago. Great views of the lake, plenty of space and not a lot of city noise. The place is clean, updated, and amazing. If you’re looking for a place to stay in Chicago, look no further!
We really enjoyed our stay!
Excellent place. Highly recommended.
Pretty great. Everything is clearly labeled. They provide you with your own set of clean towels to use. Place is very clean. Hosts are responsive.
Great place to stay at when you’re going to Wrigley Field

The house is very clean. The neighborhood is quiet. Everything matches the description. The only thing is if you use apple map, it will take you to the back street and there is no passage connecting to the front so you will have to go around. The dogs are extremely cute and well trained too.
We loved our stay here! Beyond perfect and great hosts.

We had a great weekend in Chicago.  The condo matched the description in listing, was clean and had everything we needed.  Xin was great to work with and provided all necessary information and answered messages very promptly.  We appreciated the proximity to subway which made it very easy to get around.

This place is very close to tourist attractions, restaurants, coffee shops, and stores. It's comfortable and clean, although a little small. The kitchen is well stocked and it has a washer/dryer and dishwasher in addition to the usual appliances. Lyle, the host, is accommodating and responsive. If it's nice, be sure to go up on the roof deck. We did find the bed to be a little soft. The building is fairly quiet, but it's right in the city, so there is some street noise. Overall, it's a good place to stay.

This Airbnb was a great stay for the month! It was a 15 min. walk to Lincoln Park and the lake. The neighborhood was quiet and safe. The hosts were very welcoming and answered all my questions before and during my stay as they arose.
very nice experience, with a comfortable bedroom and a very clean bathroom. The host is also hospitable. I really enjoy this stay.

This was a perfect place for my 13 week travel assignment in Seattle.  Location was perfectly drivable to downtown.  The apartment was immaculately clean, had literally everything needed for a long term stay, but wasn’t overly cluttered so I still had space for my belongings.  The host was very responsive and was so respectful of privacy.  This location is extremely quiet and great for night shift workers like myself.  There is a designated parking space in the driveway off the street that will fit 2 vehicles.  The entrance is private. I really enjoyed my stay here and would definitely return.

We stayed here during our Chicago trip for 2025 Hall of Fame ceremony and loved it! The location was very walkable, making it easy to explore the city, and the space was perfect for our family of five. Mark was incredibly accommodating and helpful—truly a great host. Highly recommended for families visiting Chicago!
Places that we like that are within 20 minutes walking places that we like that are within 20 minutes walking Bryons hot dog and Borinquen
We had a wonderful stay at Tommy and Annie’s place! Well stocked, clean, excellent location!
We had a great time staying at the bungalow! Had all the necessities. Rebecca was a great host and available when we had questions! Thank you :)

Very nice basement apartment; spotless; sofa bed is very comfortable; spacious bathroom with luxury towels; attentive hosts; no smells of any kind. Plus, nice bikes are included!
Only 2 minor negatives: 1) the bar height is very high compared to the stools; 2) you can hear noise from hosts upstairs, but this is typical when in a part of someone's residence.

We could not recommend D&J’s place more highly. Wonderful space and exceptionally kind and helpful hosts, who went out of their way, really went the extra mile, to help us as international travellers with a few tricky logistics. D&J were always extremely contactable and flexible, and their place was the perfect base from which we could walk to many of the most fabulous places in Seattle - the laminated guide to recommended sites, restaurants etc was a lovely touch. We sincerely thank you, D&J, for a wonderful stay.

Me, my husband &our teen ended up in Nashville for the first time for a concert at the Bridgestone Arena. Randy & Diane seem to have perfected how to be amazing hosts! The unit was very clean,plenty of towels & bedding, board games, anything you could really think of to make it feel comfortable.We loved the backyard, where we hung out throughout the day, fans - lots of seating&a huge table under an awning so we could still enjoy it while it was raining.
They literally thought of everything, all the way down to having labels all over the place telling you where things were located - which was a great touch! We loved it so much we ended up putting in a last minute extension, which was approved promptly.
The Germantown area was also fantastic. Could grab a scooter anywhere&head downtown or just walk around. It was quiet, the locals were all super friendly & there was plenty of restaurants nearby. Very walkable.
If we're ever back in the area, we'll definitely be staying here again!

The location was good and the room was spacious and had everything we needed. Check in was slow but the biggest problem was that the two bedroom unit was not available the first night and they didn’t notify before arrival nor did they offer a discount or any other benefit to make up for the problem. We were forced to change rooms the next day
This is our third summer staying here and it really feels like home with all the amenities and space
Very convenient location. Host was kind and  responsive.
Close to downtown which was good. No offstreet parking though as the owners Jeep was parked in the driveway.
This place was perfect for a short stay. Quiet, peaceful and all you need.
We stayed in Josh's home for a few months due to work in the area. It was the best stay!  Josh was always quick to respond and help out with anything we needed!!
All five stars! Best place to stay for the long term. Close to everything. Very responsive. I would stay there again.
Clean place and amazing host
I was in town for a conference and this place was great! Walkable to the venue downtown, the area had a neighborhood atmosphere, and the furnishing were comfortable. Highly recommended!
Laura’s place is truly nice. It is very clean and has abundant kitchen ware. Laura is a nice and kind lady. The stay was great!👍
The place was clean, comfortable, and matched the photos, with a convenient location that made getting around easy. Communication with Andrew & Rachel was clear and check-in was simple.

Great location if you need to be near the airport. Great host! Very clean bathroom and bedroom. Bed was comfortable. Towels were awesome! Host provided toiletries in case you forgot. We didn’t have to use anything but it was a nice added touch!  Would definitely come back and stay and recommend to others coming to Austin! ♥️

The location is fantastic, and the host was very responsive throughout our stay. Inside, the flooring could use some attention, there were a few areas where it felt uneven or soft underfoot, which might benefit from subfloor reinforcement. Outside, the yard has great potential but could use a little care. Enhancing the outdoor space would make it more inviting for guests to relax and enjoy the fresh air, and would also add charm and curb appeal to the property.
it was my second time staying, very clean place, friendly hosts, great location. highly recommend.

What a great place from which to explore the city. Great restaurants and coffee shops nearby. Light rail station close by made it easy to get around. Our hosts, Lila and Mark, were exceptional—friendly, gracious.
The tiny house was cute and cozy. Well setup. The hosts thought of everything. No clutter. Nice artwork.
I highly recommend this Airbnb. We’ll be back.
Cute, cozy house!

This was the best place I stayed in. It was clean and beautiful, and they made it feel like home. My girlfriend loved the bed swing. Maxine was amazing—she was super nice and kind. We will be booking again soon.

This was a great place to stay for a long-term visit. Everything was as pictured, and there were some little touches that I didn’t anticipate. They provided everything I needed that I couldn’t pack. I would definitely stay here again!
Perfect for what I needed.
What a cozy cute bungalow. Big enough for two couples or a family with children. Location was awesome and Kay was very responsive to our needs. Would highly recommend this very cute and comfy rental!
Wonderful home and a fantastic time in the city, everything walkable and a gorgeous peaceful neighborhood! Thank you Shauna for your hospitality!

I stayed at Felicity's place with my family, including 3 children under age 12 and one grandmother. All had lovely things to say about this very cute home. There were plenty of amenities and instructions laid out for the home itself as well as the surroundings. We arrived a bit early to Minneapolis and were very grateful that Felicity was flexible with us for check-in. The house has 4 total stories, with plentiful bedding. One bathroom is upstairs from the main area, and the other is in the basement. The lake as well as multiple restaurants/bars/grocery and convenience stores (and even a great resale bookstore!) are all within walking distance. We had a lovely, relaxing stay and would certainly recommend the place to anyone coming to the area.
Very responsive. Perfect place to stay for 6 months internship in downtown Chicago.
Thanks Ken! Awesome place. We enjoyed our stay.

Becky's place was perfect to settle into Logan Square for a week. As long as you plan to head out for meals, it has everything you need. All the great Logan Square and Avondale spots are walkable, and the blue line is just a few blocks away to venture out further. It was easy to work from the space with the wifi working pefectly and no noise issues. Becky and family were super friendly and great to talk to. I would definitely recommend for someone looking to stay in the area!
Perfect place, Adam was a great host. No issues at all, would 100% reccomend him and his property for other guests. A+!
I really enjoyed my stay here! The apartment matches the pictures exactly.
got the place for a month for my mother to visit. it was great

Very nice Upscale LOFT in great North Loop location. Parking located right outside front door of Loft was a plus. Amenities galore. Minnestay staff live and text communication was superb. Highly recommended.
Just like the pictures , very clean and comfortable. Had pans and pots to cook . All beds were extremely comfy. Thank you!
This place was absolutely amazing
Loved staying here! The location was perfect to walking locations for food and it was quiet and private back at their home. I will definitely stay here again when I’m in Austin.
We were in town for our son’s wedding in September. Great location, walkable, many food options available and plenty of space to relax between events.
I had a lovely stay. Lucy is an amazing host and the other roommates were great people to share the space with.
This is more a place to stay if your here for business because it is conveniently located. Quiet for getting a good night sleep.

John was an incredible host! The space is exactly as described, he is extremely helpful and responsive, and the area is spectacular—great for running along the tree-lined streets, close to the Zoo, and very easy to get downtown by car or train.

This is a great place to stay! The location is perfect for walking, neighborhood safety, and restaurants. It is just a short walk to S. 12th Street, a laid-back but stylish neighborhood with restaurants and entertainment. Also easy access without the traffic to all of Nashville’s attractions. The home was very clean, the host was very responsive, and home was exactly described as listed. The entry door for the unit was kind of confusing. Not well marked. Also, I could not lock the door going to the garage space that was used by neighboring residents. This was a safety concern and why I couldn’t give a 5 star review. Otherwise, I would highly recommend!
Perfect location
Great!

We had an amazing stay and truly appreciated all of the thoughtful recommendations and information provided. We were able to use several of them and had a wonderful experience. The amenities went above and beyond expectations: the steamer and iron were available if needed, makeup wipes, Q-tips, cotton, hair blow dryer, hair crimped, a large closet, plenty of towels, and an impressive selection of kitchen necessities along with great coffee.
The home itself was spacious, in a quiet neighborhood, and very easy for Uber and DoorDash drivers to find. The lighting and furniture made the space feel so comfortable and welcoming, and the beds were extremely comfortable. We especially loved the extra living room on the top floor. I didn’t know I needed that until we used it, and it was perfect for waiting on other guests to get ready.
Overall, we definitely recommend this property and look forward to both staying here again and exploring other properties from the same host.

lovely view. would stay again!
Starla was amazing and very responsive! she's an excellent host.
nice place - met all our requirements

We recently stayed at the Magnolia Guest House and overall, it was a nice experience. The location was incredibly convenient. We thoroughly enjoyed our morning walk to the Ballard Locks Fish Ladder, and it was just a short drive into downtown, which made exploring the city very easy.
The guesthouse itself is charmingly decorated, providing a cozy and welcoming atmosphere. The hosts have thoughtfully provided all the essentials, making our stay comfortable and hassle-free.
However, we did encounter a minor setback during our stay. The sheets on the bed could definitely use an update. The ones provided were well-worn, with noticeable rips and piling that made the texture rough against our skin. It was clear that they’ve seen better days and replacing them with a higher quality set would greatly enhance the sleeping experience.
Despite this minor issue, we had a nice stay.
Nice and quiet and peaceful. Worked perfect for my crew who is working night shift. Excellent communication and response time from owner. I would stay agian.

5 stars--a perfect stay! Leah is an amazing host and very responsive. The well-managed, professionally staffed building is located two blocks from the Red line, less than 1/2 mile from the Brown/Purple, and close to many major bus routes, making it a breeze to get around. The apartment is well-maintained and clean with plenty of towels in the bathroom, and a kitchen that has everything you need to cook meals for 1-2 people. There are three different kinds of coffee makers, an electric tea kettle, a toaster, and a good selection of knives and other small appliances. The WiFi is lightening fast, and it easily supported two simultaneous Zoom calls. The bedroom desk or dining room table provides enough workspace for traveling business needs. And, as others have noted, the view is simply fantastic! One other comment: the king-sized bed features a high-quality, comfortable mattress (a rare find at an AirBnB). Stay at Leah's place! You'll be sad to leave her marvelous home!
Fantastic stay! Great place for a bachelorette or larger group of people! Great location, house fully equipped for stay, cute tweaks for Nashville vibes. Matt was extremely responsive and helpful.

Airbnb was exactly what we needed. plenty of restaurants and things to do around the area. right near a connecting train station to get where you need. the host(s) provided tons of information and was very responsive in messaging, as well as making sure we had a seamless check-in.
would book again!!!
We had amazing experience

This was a great, private place to stay for a long work trip (3 weeks!). It had everything I needed - space, amenities (inclusive of a garage), and privacy. Thanks Pat. I look forward to staying at your place again in November. The quiet peaceful home was precisely what I needed. I’m grateful.
Had a great time at Tim's place, had everything we needed and it was exactly as described. Would definitely stay again!

Highly recommend booking this if you’re looking for a room with no hassle. Jennifer is super friendly and very welcoming!

Great location very near Michigan Avenue and the Northwestern Hospitals, but a street off makes it much quieter. The apartment was well put together except the bar stools were too high for the counter so working on a laptop was a bit tricky. The building was friendly. The rooftop sundeck and pool were great in the summer. Work out room, laundry & parking in the building were all a winner for us. We brought our dog and there are a lot of dogs in the building - all well versed in elevator etiquette. We'd stay there again.

Enjoyable stay for the weekend. I went with a friend for a concert, a good spot to crash for a night or two if you're looking for a place to sleep and a free parking situation. I can't say much about how it would be if you plan on staying for an extended time or staying inside a lot since everything besides your room is shared with the other guests too.

Great location, very walkable. The towels smell wonderful. The unit was super clean and had everything you need. Close to Lincoln Square and Andersonville. I was visiting my daughter and we had great time. Lots to see and do. Jacob the host was very responsive, informative, and friendly. I would stay here again.
I had a great stay at Kyle & Jamie’s house, I would stay here again
Great place! Super close to shopping center makes everything very convenient! Great host
We enjoyed our stay.
Tarik was a very welcoming host, giving good recommendations on things to do in the area and even bringing me along for a hike with his friends.
Cute cabin. Great communication. Lovely lake. Enjoyed my stay.

I had a great long term stay at Marie’s place! The location could not be better. The flat is beautiful and has everything one could need. Some small things occurred during my long stay, but Marie took care of everything right away and made my stay perfect! I would stay here every time when visiting Chicago! Best place & host!
had an amazing stay and was very good priced for what you were getting.
Would definitely stay again. Thanks Terry.
Communication excellent and all went smoothly.

Room 5 was clean and comfortable and more than met our needs for the night. Our two dogs were comfortable there as well. It's a good sized, corner room with all necessary amenities provided. There are five windows overlooking an intersection at the edge of downtown Rush City. One of the windows was missing it's pull down shade so we improvised one. Senior guests, such as myself, should beware of the claw foot tub serving as a shower, utilizing a 360° ring of shower curtain. I found the tub somewhat difficult to get in and out of, the footing unsure, and the flimsy curtain to be a nuisance. Room 5 is directly above the restaurant/bar and there was a moderate level of noise until about 10pm (Saturday night). There is very little vehicular noise from the streets below. All-in-all we enjoyed our stay in this historic property and appreciate the owners efforts to preserve it as an operational hotel.
Quick response from host! Lots of space and great value!

Beautiful dorm-style building, with modest space (but perfect if you’re going to be out and about in the city). Good budget option. Only off note was that there was a number to text for assistance, but the questions seemed to be answered on a delay as though it were a real person but the actual answers seemed automated. If it’s an AI why not have it answer immediately?
Honestly, this place truly did the trick. It’s a nice spot if you need a quick stay. Very personable and peaceful. Perfect for a solo trip.
El lugar es justo como se describe. Es un lugar muy cómodo y limpio. Consideren las escaleras para personas con alguna discapacidad. Muy bien lugar. Volvería sin duda
We had a great stay here

Wonderful stay! Clean and new. We are not big on campers but definitely a great option with La! Bathroom was nice and fresh and clean. We used the stove top and oven and both worked great. The bed was comfortable and the AC was outstanding. Also lots of hi tech stuff. One of our days rained in the morning and I was able to use the flat screen smart TV and use Netflix and Disney plus. An amazing sty overall. Thanks!
Place is well maintained . It’s small but it is perfect if you are traveling alone or with one other person.
Fantastic place abd stay for me

The building is very well located.  We already miss the rooftop sunsets and the pool! Everyone we came across from staff to other residents were incredible.  Great culture all around! A joy to be there!

I really enjoyed my 6 week stay here. This apartment is in a prime location and Kari was also responsive to any issues that arose during my stay.
Pros: The location the best I could have hoped for - close to the river, restaurants, bars, shopping, gyms, transit lines, Whole Foods, etc., and I felt safe walking around in the evening. The apartment itself was spacious, comfortable, and had amazing views. The building has nice amenities (24 hour doorman, gym, rooftop).
Cons: The apartment is on a main road, so there is street noise at night. Floor to ceiling windows are great for natural light, but it can get bright in the early morning even with the blinds drawn. Had to buy some cooking essentials that weren't provided (cutting board, baking sheet).
It was good for the night—I would have liked a fan or something to keep airflow as it was pretty stagnant. Otherwise, everything was great!

Susan has a wonderful house, we stayed at her place for 7 days and enjoyed the huge kitchen, balcony and the yard area to the fullest ( esp in the evening). Not to mention a variety of books offered for reading, which we greatly appreciated. It was a plum tree season, so Susan told us to feel free to pick up the plums, and she even picked up a bag of plums for us before our arrival. The house is located close to the bus stations, so it was convenient to use public transportation to go to downtown Seattle and Alki Beach. Great place for a couple or a family stay

The place was just perfect, during night very quite for Chicago standards. The building where the unit is located is top spot location, you do not need to use any public transportation or Uber/Lyft in that matter. The place was very clean and looks just like on pictures, the only minus is that floor is squeaky while walking on it other than that everything is very nice. The host very friendly and very responsive. A++++

Amazing little place to stay in perfect for my wife and I. It’s in a great location close to just about everything you can do in Nashville. Cyndi was great from the very moment we booked, gave us a ton of places to check out and she was very responsive to any of our questions. If we are ever back in Nashville we will definitely be looking for this place. Thank you Cyndi!

My partner and I stayed here six nights and worked remotely for a few of those days. Suzanne’s AirBnB was perfectly clean, had fast WiFi, all the amenities listed including washer and dryer, and a comfortable bed. The house also gets a lot of great natural light and even has a private patio where the WiFi works. Very safe and quiet neighborhood that is walkable to good restaurants and coffee shops, and only a 20 minute walk or jog to the water and lots more places to go out. Definitely recommend staying here!
Overall great location. Great host. Very comfortable. Heated floors in the bathroom was a huge plus.

Gretchen’s space was perfect for our visit. She provided amenities and extra thoughtful touches to make ourselves as comfortable as possible! Its location proved to be excellent when navigating to and from Broadway without being caught up in the middle of it! I will definitely be staying there again!

Very little is wrong with the actual location. Conveniently close to food and transit stops. The only downside is noise, specifically the back alley where every few days garbage trucks empty the neighbor's dumpsters very late at night, and right by the window. Had I known this beforehand I may have reconsidered, especially considering the price being asked. Aside from that, however, the location is fine.
Enjoyed our stay! Would highly recommend.

Superbe logement. Vous avez le sous-sol pour vous.
Tout est très propre. Rien à dire.
J'aimerais écrire ce commentaire pour les femmes qui voyagent seule. Bien que le logement est superbe et proche du centre-ville (une ligne de bus très pratique). Si vous êtes seule et rentrée tard (dans mon cas en raison de conferences), vous devez faire attention à ne pas être agressée ou abordée de manière très non-chalentes (à la limite de la violence). Bien que le logement soit super, la localisation n'est pas recommandée si vous êtes une femme seule et si vous ne privilégiez pas les taxis ou uber.
Ce commentaire n'est pas contre l'hote qui a été remarquable mais je veux prévenir pour les autres personnes (en particulier les femmes qui viennent seules et que vous n'êtes pas de Seattle) que la localisation n'est pas idéale.
Merci encore à l'hôte qui a été vraiment gentil et l'hôte n'y est pour rien pour le commentaire concernant les femmes qui voyagent seules!

A couple things to note, however, we heard several sets of gunshots both nights and the upstairs tenants are quite loud really late at night and early in the morning. I brought my own fan to help me sleep so I was able to tune it out but if you’re a light sleeper it can definitely keep you up. I’m used to gunshots back home but there were quite a lot throughout both nights and lots of sirens - definitely not an area I’d walk through at night. We stayed in a different airbnb on the north side for about a week after checking out where the neighborhood was much quieter and felt safer. But in a pinch for the weekend, it was doable.
Great host and great house! Thank you, Vacay!
